BetterHelp accepts insurance through many major insurance plans — eligible members pay an average copay of $23 per session. Get matched with a therapist who gets you We accept HSA/FSA for Individual and Teen therapy What is online therapy? Online therapy is professional mental health treatment delivered by a licensed therapist online through video sessions, phone calls, live chat, or secure messaging, without visiting an office. Research shows it can be just as effective as in-person therapy for conditions including anxiety, depression, PTSD, and relationship concerns. BetterHelp's online therapy platform is designed to remove common barriers to care. You're matched with a licensed therapist based on your needs, preferences, and location, often within as little as 24–48 hours. With BetterHelp, online therapy makes it easy to: Connect with a licensed therapist your way — video, phone, live chat, or messaging Attend sessions from home, while traveling, or wherever you are Schedule therapy on your time — flexible sessions that fit your life Get matched with a therapist based on your needs, preferences, and location, often within days Enjoy added comfort and control over how you engage in your care Receive the same professional support you'd expect from in-person therapy Why choose BetterHelp for online therapy Benefits of online therapy with the BetterHelp platform Affordable pricing With or without insurance Discreet appointments Sessions from anywhere with an internet connection One of the world's largest network of therapists More than 30,000 qualified providers worldwide Comprehensive matching system Find the right therapist for you No long wait times Average match time is 24-48 hours The right therapist for you Switch therapists at no extra cost Proven results Industry-leading user satisfaction How online therapy works Online therapy through BetterHelp is straightforward, effective, and easy to use. Here's how it works: 1 Fill out a 5-minute assessment. Answer a short series of questions about your virtual care preferences and mental health to help us find the right therapist for your mental health needs. 2 Get your monthly cost estimate. Receive a monthly quote for online therapy; cost is typically $70-100/week billed monthly, and depends on factors such as location, preferences, insurance, and therapist availability. BetterHelp accepts many insurance plans, helping more people access therapy with licensed providers online. Eligible members’ average copay is $23 per session. In some cases, financial assistance may be available depending on income/employment status. 3 Most match with a therapist in 24-48 hours. Quickly match with a qualified therapist who is licensed in your state, has been rigorously vetted, and who aligns with your specific needs—96% of users matched with a therapist within 24 hours in 2024, and 93% of user preferences were met in 2024. 4 Start therapy. Begin finding relief for your concerns with weekly online therapy sessions. Weekly sessions are included in your subscription, and can range from 30-45 minutes. 5 Get ongoing support outside of sessions. Take advantage of a massive library of worksheets, goal and habit tracking tools, journaling, 300+ support groups, and 35+ educational classes for mental health support and accelerate your healing journey, and message your therapist anytime. Ready to get started? Begin your healing journey today 72% of BetterHelp users experienced a reduction in symptoms in 12 weeks 4.9 out of 5 average rating for a live session, from over 1.7 million client ratings 82% of clients in treatment likely to recommend their therapist to others 93% of user preferences met when matching with a therapist Source: BetterHelp Platform Quality & Outcomes (2024) Online therapy vs. in-person therapy: how they compare Online Therapy Lower cost: $70-100/week or $23 average insurance co-pay/session for eligible members* Short wait time: most matched within 24-48 hours One of the largest online network of providers: 30,000+ licensed therapists worldwide with 1,000+ clinical hours Sessions from anywhere: meet with a therapist wherever you prefer, including from the comfort of home Comprehensive therapist matching, done for you: simply answer a few questions to get matched with a therapist who fits your needs Easy to switch therapists: easily switch therapists anytime, at no additional cost Proven, platform-specific results: 72% of BetterHelp users experienced a reduction in symptoms in 12 weeks of beginning treatment Traditional, in-person therapy Higher cost: $100-350/session Long wait time: average wait time of 13 weeks before first appointment (US) Limited options for providers: constrained to nearby providers with varied backgrounds and credentials Sessions from a therapist’s office: risk of running into others, possibility of long commutes, scheduling difficulties Burden of finding the right therapist is on you: search through hundreds of profiles and call dozens of offices to try to find a good match Complicated and time-consuming to switch therapists: no streamlined process to switch therapists Demonstrated general effectiveness: research shows online therapy can be just as effective as in-person therapy for various concerns For many people, the cost of therapy, shortage of mental health providers, stigma of seeking help, and long wait times for mental health services can present significant barriers to seeking therapy and the help they need. BetterHelp aims to dismantle these barriers by making therapy affordable, convenient, discreet, and fast—making prohibitive cost, shame, and long waits all things of the past. Take a brave step towards finding support by getting started with the best online therapy platform. In the time it takes to wait for your first in-person therapy appointment—12 weeks, on average—you could have already reduced your symptoms through BetterHelp online therapy, as 72% of users reported symptom reduction in 12 weeks. Who online therapy is for and what we treat Is online therapy right for you? Learn more about what BetterHelp treats and who we help. What conditions can online therapists treat? BetterHelp has over 30,000 trained, professional therapists globally, spanning a wide range of treatment approaches and areas of expertise, like CBT therapy, who are skilled in supporting individuals with a wide variety of mental health conditions and concerns. Many individuals turn to BetterHelp for help with the following: Anxiety Depression Trauma Relationship issues Stress Job burnout Postpartum concerns Life transitions Self-esteem ADHD Grief and loss Obsessive compulsive disorder Sleep issues Family conflicts Substance use Eating disorders Bipolar disorder Intimacy-related issues Anger management Parenting issues Who can benefit from online therapy? BetterHelp offers individual therapy services for adults of all genders, ages, sexualities, and backgrounds. In addition, BetterHelp has sister sites dedicated to various other audiences and specific challenges, including Regain for couples therapy and TeenCounseling for teens aged 13 to 19. Individuals Teens Couples Veterans Young Adults Seniors Meet BetterHelp's licensed online therapists All medical professionals and therapists providing online therapy or mental health services through BetterHelp must undergo a rigorous vetting process and meet a strict set of minimum criteria: Relevant academic degree in their field (such as a master’s degree, PhD, or PsyD) Licensed mental health professional in their state At least 3 years of experience At least 1,000 hours of hands-on experience Therapists also undergo a background report, are subject to periodic checks, and must complete a case study graded
